verdict.rationale: The evidence shows developer building blocks rather than a user-facing automation feature. The Connect APIs and Apps SDK can 'automate common design tasks', autofill Brand Templates and auto-resize designs, but a developer would have to build any background automation on top of them. Nothing documents user-configurable automations that run autonomously, such as schedules, triggers or recurring background jobs; the MCP server is driven on demand by an AI assistant, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
